map.历史销售数据（每行一个数值，按时间顺序，至少 3 期）: Historical sales data (one value per line, in time order, at least 3 periods)
map.取最近 N 期算术平均作为下期预测: Use the arithmetic mean of the last N periods as the next-period forecast
map.近期权重更高（权重 N,N-1,...,1）: Higher weight on recent periods (weights N,N-1,...,1)
map.按同期环比增长率外推（需至少一个周期）: Extrapolate by same-period growth rate (needs at least one cycle)
map.基于模型残差标准差的近似 95% 置信区间（预测值 ± 1.96σ）；样本不足时: Approximate 95% confidence interval from the model residual standard deviation (forecast ± 1.96σ); when samples are insufficient it falls back to the historical standard deviation, and the result area notes which basis was used. For reference only; actual forecast error is affected by many factors.
map.移动平均预测：用近 N 期均值外推未来，适合平稳无强趋势的序列。: Moving-average forecast: extrapolate from the mean of the last N periods, suitable for stationary series with no strong trend.
map.预测：拟合历史趋势线 y=a+bx，外推未来，适合持续增长/下滑序列。: Forecast: fit the historical trend line y=a+bx and extrapolate, suitable for sustained growth/decline series.
map.季节性预测：按周期长度用同比环比增长率外推，适合月度/季度强周期业务。: Seasonal forecast: extrapolate by cycle-length YoY/MoM growth rate, suitable for monthly/quarterly strongly cyclical business.
map.举例：序列 [100,120,110,130,140]，移动平均 N=3 预测: Example: series [100,120,110,130,140], moving average N=3 forecasting 2 periods
map.第1期预测 = 最近3期均值 (110+130+140)/3 = 126.67；:
Period 1 forecast = mean of last 3 (110+130+140)/3 = 126.67; add it to the series then forecast period 2 = (130+140+126.67)/3 ≈ 132.22.
With linear regression, fit the trend then extrapolate periods 6 and 7 (x=6,7), better for monotonic trends; the seasonal pattern extrapolates by the 'same period last year → this year' growth rate.

map.置信区间怎么理解？: How to interpret the confidence interval?
map.工具按模型残差标准差 σ 给出 ±1.96σ 区间，表示约 95% 可能落在该范: The tool gives a ±1.96σ interval based on the model residual standard deviation σ, meaning about 95% of outcomes fall in this range; when samples are insufficient it falls back to the historical standard deviation and notes the basis in the result area. The larger σ and the more volatile the series, the wider the interval and the less reliable the forecast, so judge with business context.

map.销售预测是一款销售管理领域的在线工具。销售管理工具，帮助量化业绩与提成计算。: Sales Forecast is an online tool in sales management. Sales management tools help quantify performance and commission calculation.
map.销售预测四法（移动平均/加权/线性回归/季节）: Four Sales Forecasting Methods (moving average / weighted / linear regression / seasonal)
map.SMA：下期 = 最近 N 期简单平均: SMA: next period = simple average of the latest N periods
map.WMA：权重按距预测期远近分配（近期权重大）: WMA: weights are assigned by distance from the forecast period (recent periods weigh more)
map.LR：最小二乘拟合 ŷ = a + b·t，b 为趋势斜率: LR: least-squares fit ŷ = a + b·t, where b is the trend slope
map.季节法：按季节周期长度分解趋势与季节分量: Seasonal method: decompose trend and seasonal components by the seasonal cycle length
map.输出：历史均值、历史标准差、趋势方向: Outputs: historical mean, historical standard deviation, trend direction
map.输入校验：至少 3 期历史数据: Validation: at least 3 periods of historical data
map.预测期数可调，逐期滚动递推: The number of forecast periods is adjustable, rolled forward period by period
